tools.name: list_rwa_yields
tools.description: Lists tokenized real-world asset deployments (tokenized US treasuries, credit, funds) with current APY and TVL, from public DefiLlama data. Filter by chain or kind. Information only, not advice.

tools.description: Returns every deployment of one tokenized asset symbol (e.g. BUIDL, USDY, OUSG) across chains, with total TVL and curated description.

tools.name: compare_yield_to_tokenized_treasuries
tools.description: Given an APY the user currently earns (e.g. a bank savings rate), computes the simple-interest difference versus the highest-yielding liquid tokenized treasury over a horizon. Returns arithmetic and assumptions only; it does not recommend.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Creates a free YieldCave API key (1000 calls/day, 3 alerts, 7 days of history) tied to an email address. The key is shown once. Send it on every request as an x-api-key header or Authorization: Bearer. One key per email.

tools.name: my_usage
tools.description: Shows the caller's plan, calls used today, remaining allowance, alert allowance, depth limits, and what each plan includes.

tools.description: Returns a checkout link for the Pro plan ($49/month: full history and changes, all stablecoin venues, full issuer terms, 100 alerts, 5000 calls/day). Needs an API key.

tools.description: Returns a Stripe Billing Portal link to update payment details, see invoices, or cancel the Pro subscription. Needs an API key with a subscription.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_api_key" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_alerts · Private data: rwa_market_summary, list_stablecoin_yields, list_tokenized_equities, tokenized_equity_summary, rwa_issuer_terms, create_api_key, upgrade, manage_subscription · Public sink: create_alert, list_alerts, create_api_key · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_alerts · Private data: rwa_market_summary, list_stablecoin_yields, list_tokenized_equities, tokenized_equity_summary, rwa_issuer_terms, create_api_key, upgrade, manage_subscription · Public sink: create_alert, list_alerts, create_api_key · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
